title: Writer|LibreOffice|Без имени
pre: [IO.File]::WriteAllText("$env:APPDATA\LibreOffice\4\user\registrymodifications.xcu",'<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><oor:items xmlns:oor="http://openoffice.org/2001/registry" xmlns:xs="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"><item oor:path="/org.openoffice.Setup/L10N"><prop oor:name="ooLocale" oor:op="fuse"><value>ru</value></prop></item><item oor:path="/org.openoffice.Setup/L10N"><prop oor:name="ooSetupSystemLocale" oor:op="fuse"><value>ru-RU</value></prop></item><item oor:path="/org.openoffice.Office.Common/Misc"><prop oor:name="FirstRun" oor:op="fuse"><value>false</value></prop></item><item oor:path="/org.openoffice.Office.Common/Misc"><prop oor:name="ShowTipOfTheDay" oor:op="fuse"><value>false</value></prop></item></oor:items>',(New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding $false))
Log ("ru dirs: " + ((Get-ChildItem "C:\Program Files\LibreOffice" -Recurse -Directory -Filter ru -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 5 | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName }) -join "; "))
